QuestInfo.name: The Lonely Unicorn, Bjorn
QuestInfo.0: Whenever you are with the unicorns Esel and Tiel, you feel a mysterious energy in the air.
QuestInfo.1: Explore Maple World with Esel and Tiel.
QuestInfo.2: Bjorn let Esel and Tiel be his friends and stay together.
